source: vscode wiki page Issues-Triaging, https://github.com/microsoft/vscode.wiki.git commit 49c140c8edb797c8237ea3070c85f35055868cdf (2026-08-27), fetched 2026-10-16
note: Text copied verbatim. 'type' is the row of the 'Categorizing Issues' table; 'closing_reason' is the row of the 'Closing Issues' table that names the label, where there is one.

bug.type: the implementation of a feature is not correct

under-discussion.type: not decided whether the issue is a bug or feature

*question.type: we should direct questions to StackOverflow
*question.closing_reason: The issue is a user question.

upstream.type: an issue used to track an issue in an upstream component
upstream.closing_reason: The issue is tracked in a repository we rely on.

upstream-issue-linked.type: an issue used to track an issue in an upstream component
upstream-issue-linked.closing_reason: The issue is tracked in a repository we rely on.

engineering.type: issues related to our engineering system or our processes

polish.type: a feature could be improved, but not necessarily a bug
